3: /**
4:  * DopeParameters contain the two different parameter types for DopeQueries.
5:  * It is assumed that [positionalParameters] are sorted, provided that
6:  * [merge] is always called upon the first member in the sequence of the query itself.
7:  *
8:  * @property namedParameters A map containing the name of parameters (key) and their respective values (value)
9:  * @property positionalParameters A sorted list containing all values of positional (unnamed) parameters
10:  */
11: data class DopeParameters(
12:     val namedParameters: Map<String, Any> = emptyMap(),
13:     val positionalParameters: List<Any> = emptyList(),
14: ) {
15:     /**
16:      * Merges multiple instances of DopeParameters, so that the receiver instance of [DopeParameters]
17:      * is the first in the order of merging.
18:      */
19:     fun merge(vararg otherParameters: DopeParameters?) = this.copy(
20:         namedParameters = otherParameters.filterNotNull().fold(this.namedParameters) {
21:                 namedParams, additionalNamedParams ->
22:             namedParams + additionalNamedParams.namedParameters
23:         },
24:         positionalParameters = otherParameters.filterNotNull().fold(this.positionalParameters) {
25:                 positionalParams, additionalPositionalParams ->
26:             positionalParams + additionalPositionalParams.positionalParameters
27:         },
28:     )
29: }
30: 
31: fun List<DopeParameters>.merge(vararg otherParameters: DopeParameters?): DopeParameters =
32:     this.fold(DopeParameters()) { parameters, additionalParameters ->
33:         parameters.merge(additionalParameters)
34:     }.merge(*otherParameters)
35: 
36: fun DopeParameters?.orEmpty(): DopeParameters = this ?: DopeParameters()
